verdict.rationale: llamafile documents support for GGUF models, the standard format shared with llama.cpp-based runtimes, which implies model files may be interoperable. However, its core design embeds the weights inside a single self-contained executable, and the evidence never states whether those bundled weights or existing downloads can be reused across runtimes. Missing for 10: explicit docs on loading external GGUF files already downloaded for other runtimes, docs on extracting or reusing weights embedded in a llamafile, any statement on cache locations or sharing, and hands-on corroboration of cross-runtime reuse without re-downloading or re-converting.
